name: Job Loss Transition
description: Produces structured transition plans for immediate financial stabilization after job loss, covering 30-day action plans, benefits continuation checklists (COBRA timeline, unemployment filing), expense reduction frameworks, and job search reactivation sequences. Focuses on the immediate practical steps to stabilize finances and relaunch a career search within the first 30-90 days. Use when the user asks about what to do after losing a job, managing finances during unemployment, or organizing a job loss recovery plan. Do NOT use for long-term career coaching (use career-development skills), detailed job search strategy (use job search skills), or mental health treatment for job loss depression.
